goal: Stop evicting transactions from the mempool based purely on how long they have waited
Prevents dropping mineable transactions such as low-fee parents waiting on fee bumps
Reduces per-entry memory overhead so nodes can fit more transactions within the same memory limit
agreement: Objection that complete removal prevents node operators from reverting if harmful (ajtowns)
Concept approval arguing historical reasons for expiry no longer hold (stickies-v)
Concept approval referencing historical discussion on earlier PRs (maflcko)
Approval from an account with no project history gave no stated reasons (tumutech)

categories.name: mempool
why: P2 because it stops evicting valid mineable transactions that are waiting on fee bumps
Removes an eviction policy that works against miner incentives when mempools are not full
Decreases memory overhead per entry so node operators can fit more transactions under maxmempool
